notes: Referral fees vary by product category.
Closing fees vary by selling-price range and fulfilment channel.
Weight-handling fees vary by chargeable weight and shipping distance.
Amazon states that displayed selling fees exclude GST and 18% GST is applied to those fees.
Seller-specific/current calculator output is still required before economics may be marked VERIFIED.
Fixed fees vary by selling-price range and FBF/NFBF fulfilment.
Collection fees vary by selling price and payment mode.
Shipping fees vary by chargeable weight and local/zonal/national movement.
Flipkart recommends using the seller account for accurate current rates; seller-specific/current inputs are required before economics may be marked VERIFIED.
